title: Listening Comprehension
description: Section 1: 50 questions in about 35 minutes on short conversations, longer conversations and academic talks, each heard only once.

id.title: Listening Comprehension
id.description: Section 1: 50 soal dalam sekitar 35 menit tentang percakapan pendek, percakapan panjang dan ceramah akademik, masing-masing hanya diputar sekali.

nodes.title: Part A: Short Conversations
nodes.summary: Two speakers, one question, four printed answers.

objectives.text: Identify that the answer usually depends on what the second speaker says
Choose the option that paraphrases what was said instead of the one that repeats similar-sounding words
Recognise the common question stems (What does the man mean? What will the woman probably do next?)

id.title: Part A: Percakapan Pendek
id.summary: Dua pembicara, satu pertanyaan, empat jawaban tercetak.

objectives.focus-second-speaker: Menyadari bahwa jawaban biasanya bergantung pada ucapan pembicara kedua
objectives.paraphrase-match: Memilih opsi yang memparafrasekan isi ucapan, bukan opsi yang mengulang kata yang bunyinya mirip
objectives.common-question-stems: Mengenali bentuk pertanyaan yang sering muncul (What does the man mean? What will the woman probably do next?)

nodes.title: Idioms and Implied Meaning
nodes.summary: Understand idioms, suggestions and agreement that speakers never say directly.

objectives.text: Interpret common spoken idioms and phrasal verbs in campus conversations
Infer agreement, disagreement, surprise or a suggestion from an indirect reply
Understand tricky negatives and wishes or conditions (e.g. 'I couldn't agree more', 'If only I had known')

id.title: Idiom dan Makna Tersirat
id.summary: Memahami idiom, saran dan persetujuan yang tidak diucapkan secara langsung.

objectives.common-idioms: Menafsirkan idiom lisan dan phrasal verb yang umum dalam percakapan kampus
objectives.implied-response: Menyimpulkan persetujuan, ketidaksetujuan, keterkejutan atau saran dari jawaban tidak langsung
objectives.negatives-conditions: Memahami kalimat negatif yang menjebak serta harapan atau pengandaian (mis. 'I couldn't agree more', 'If only I had known')

nodes.title: Part B: Longer Conversations
nodes.summary: Follow a campus conversation and answer several questions about it.

objectives.text: Answer 'What are the speakers mainly discussing?' from the opening lines
Track details, problems and decisions in the order they are mentioned
Preview the printed options to predict what to listen for

id.title: Part B: Percakapan Panjang
id.summary: Mengikuti percakapan di kampus dan menjawab beberapa pertanyaan tentangnya.

objectives.topic-question: Menjawab 'What are the speakers mainly discussing?' dari kalimat-kalimat pembuka
objectives.track-details: Mengikuti detail, masalah dan keputusan sesuai urutan penyebutannya
objectives.preview-options: Membaca sekilas opsi tercetak untuk menebak informasi yang perlu didengarkan

nodes.title: Part C: Talks and Lectures
nodes.summary: Understand short academic talks and announcements heard only once.

objectives.text: Identify the main topic or purpose of a talk
Use signal words (first, however, as a result, for example) to follow the structure of a lecture
Recall key facts, examples and causes mentioned in the talk

id.title: Part C: Ceramah dan Pengumuman
id.summary: Memahami ceramah akademik singkat dan pengumuman yang hanya diputar sekali.

objectives.main-purpose: Menentukan topik utama atau tujuan sebuah ceramah
objectives.signal-words: Memakai kata penanda (first, however, as a result, for example) untuk mengikuti struktur ceramah
objectives.detail-recall: Mengingat fakta kunci, contoh dan sebab yang disebutkan dalam ceramah

nodes.title: Note-Taking and Predicting
nodes.summary: Short notes and smart predictions for conversations and talks you hear once.

objectives.text: Take brief notes (keywords, numbers, abbreviations) of main idea, major points and details
Predict likely questions from the printed options before the audio starts
Guess and move on after a missed question so the next one is not lost

id.title: Mencatat dan Memprediksi
id.summary: Catatan singkat dan prediksi cerdas untuk percakapan dan ceramah yang hanya didengar sekali.

objectives.short-notes: Membuat catatan singkat (kata kunci, angka, singkatan) tentang ide utama, poin besar dan detail
objectives.predict-questions: Memprediksi pertanyaan yang mungkin muncul dari opsi tercetak sebelum audio dimulai
objectives.recover-quickly: Menebak lalu lanjut setelah melewatkan satu soal agar soal berikutnya tidak ikut hilang
